of which is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to this report, The Cheesecake Factory Incorporated (the &#8220;Company&#8221;) reported financial
results for the first quarter of fiscal 2026, which ended on March 31, 2026.</p>

<P STYLE="font: 14pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>THE CHEESECAKE
FACTORY REPORTS RESULTS FOR</B>&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 14pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>FIRST QUARTER
OF FISCAL 2026</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B><I>CALABASAS HILLS, Calif. &ndash; April&nbsp;29,
2026 </I></B>&ndash; The Cheesecake Factory Incorporated (NASDAQ: CAKE) today reported financial results for the first quarter of fiscal
2026, which ended on March&nbsp;31, 2026.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Total revenues were $978.8 million in the
first quarter of fiscal 2026 compared to $927.2 million in the first quarter of fiscal 2025. Net income and diluted net income per
share were $49.5 million and $1.02, respectively, in the first quarter of fiscal 2026.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Company recorded a pre-tax net expense of
$2.0 million related to impairment of assets and lease termination expenses, and Fox Restaurant Concepts (&ldquo;FRC&rdquo;) acquisition-related
items. Excluding the after-tax impact of these items, adjusted net income and adjusted diluted net income per share for the first quarter
of fiscal 2026 were $51.1 million and $1.05, respectively. Please see the Company&rsquo;s reconciliation of non-GAAP financial measures
at the end of this press release.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Comparable restaurant sales at The Cheesecake
Factory restaurants increased 1.6% year-over-year in the first quarter of fiscal 2026.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&ldquo;We delivered strong first quarter results,
with revenue, margins and earnings finishing above our expectations,&rdquo; said David Overton, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.
&ldquo;Our top-line performance was led by comparable sales growth at The Cheesecake Factory restaurants, which outperformed the broader
casual dining industry in the quarter. These results, delivered in a competitive environment and despite significant weather-related impacts,
reflect the resilient demand for the distinct, high-quality dining experiences we provide our guests and strong affinity for our namesake
concept. At the same time, execution within our restaurants was excellent, with operators driving year-over-year improvements in labor
productivity and food efficiency, supporting solid flow-through to profitability.&rdquo;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Mr.&nbsp;Overton continued, &ldquo;For more than
four decades, our approach has been grounded in a commitment to taking care of our guests and each other, delivering exceptional hospitality
and memorable dining experiences that set our concepts apart. We are honored to be recognized on the Fortune magazine &lsquo;100 Best
Companies to Work For&rsquo; list for the 13<SUP>th</SUP> consecutive year, a distinction that reflects the strength of our culture, how
our teams bring our values to life across our restaurants every day, and reinforces our position as an employer of choice.&rdquo;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="border-top: Black 1pt solid; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">26901 Malibu Hills
Road, Calabasas Hills, CA 91301 <FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT> Telephone (818) 871-3000</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Development</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">During the first quarter of fiscal 2026, the Company
opened one North Italia, one Flower Child, one FRC restaurant, and one The Cheesecake Factory restaurant opened internationally under
a licensing agreement in Guadalajara, Mexico. Subsequent to quarter-end, the Company opened one North Italia location.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Company continues to expect to open as many
as 26 new restaurants in fiscal 2026, including as many as six The Cheesecake Factory restaurants, six to seven North Italia locations,
six to seven Flower Child locations and as many as seven FRC restaurants.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>Liquidity and Capital Allocation</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">As of March&nbsp;31, 2026, the Company had total
available liquidity of $601.6 million, including a cash balance of $235.1 million and $366.5 million of availability on its revolving
credit facility with no outstanding balance. Total principal amount of debt outstanding was $644.0 million, including $69.0 million in
principal amount of 0.375% convertible senior notes due 2026 and $575.0 million in principal amount of 2.00% convertible senior notes
due 2030.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">During the first quarter of fiscal 2026, the Company
repurchased approximately 332,000 shares of its stock at a cost of $19.2 million. In addition, the Company&rsquo;s Board of Directors
has declared a quarterly dividend of $0.30 per share to be paid on May&nbsp;26, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business
on May&nbsp;13, 2026.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>Conference Call and Webcast</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Company will hold a conference call to review
its results for the first quarter of fiscal 2026 today at 2:00 p.m.&nbsp;Pacific Time. The conference call will be webcast live on the
Company&rsquo;s website at investors.thecheesecakefactory.com.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>About The Cheesecake Factory Incorporated</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Cheesecake Factory Incorporated is a leader
in experiential dining. We are culinary forward and relentlessly focused on hospitality. Delicious, memorable experiences created by
passionate people&mdash;this defines who we are and where we are going. We currently own and operate 371 restaurants throughout the United
States and Canada under brands including The Cheesecake Factory<SUP>&reg;</SUP>, North Italia<SUP>&reg;</SUP>, Flower Child<SUP>&reg;</SUP>
and a collection of other FRC brands. Internationally, 36 The Cheesecake Factory<SUP>&reg;</SUP> restaurants operate under licensing
agreements. Our bakery division operates two facilities that produce quality cheesecakes and other baked products for our restaurants,
international licensees and third-party bakery customers. In 2026, we were named to the FORTUNE Magazine &ldquo;100 Best Companies to
Work For<SUP>&reg;</SUP>&rdquo; list for the thirteenth consecutive year. To learn more, visit <U>www.thecheesecakefactory.com</U>, <U>www.northitalia.com</U>,
<U>www.iamaflowerchild.com</U> and <U>www.foxrc.com</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Reconciliation of Non-GAAP Results to GAAP Results</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">In addition to the results provided in accordance
with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America (&ldquo;GAAP&rdquo;) in this press release, the Company
is providing non-GAAP measurements which present net income and net income per share excluding the impact of certain items. The non-GAAP
measurements are intended to supplement the presentation of the Company&rsquo;s financial results in accordance with GAAP. These non-GAAP
measures are calculated by eliminating from net income and diluted net income per share the impact of items the Company does not consider
indicative of its ongoing operations. The Company uses these non-GAAP financial measures for financial and operational decision-making
and as a means to evaluate period-to-period comparisons.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: center; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><B>The Cheesecake Factory Incorporated </B></FONT></P>

Non-GAAP Financial Measures

adjusted net income, adjusted diluted net income per common share, adjusted net income margin and adjusted earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortization (&#x201C;EBITDA&#x201D;). The non-GAAP
measurements are intended to supplement the presentation of the Company&#x2019;s financial results in accordance with GAAP. The Company believes that the presentation of these items provides additional information
to facilitate the comparison of past and present financial results. These non-GAAP measures may not be comparable to similarly-titled measures used by other companies and should not be considered in isolation
or as a substitute for measures of performance prepared in accordance with GAAP. We calculate these non-GAAP measures by eliminating from cash flow from operations, net income, diluted net income per
